name: Transit Finance
rootCause: Transit Finance recorded a reported $257,800 exploit on Ethereum on 2026-04-20. Public evidence for this specific incident remains limited to exploit catalogues and monitoring dashboards, and no verified exploit transaction, vulnerable contract, or technical postmortem describing the attack mechanism has been identified. Unknown. Public exploit catalogues list the April 2026 Ethereum incident under a protocol-logic classification, but no primary disclosure, verified exploit transaction, vulnerable contract, or technical analysis establishing the failure mechanism was located.
